candidates.a: Calm minimal ambient instrumental at 120 BPM. Soft warm synth pads, sparse felt piano notes and a light marimba motif, a very quiet steady pulse, airy and bright, unhurried, modern product film mood. Resolves to a clean soft ending at the end. No vocals, no drums.
candidates.b: Gentle piano-led instrumental at 120 BPM, simple repeating four-note piano figure with soft pad underneath and a faint low pulse, quiet, clean, optimistic and focused, like a calm software demo. Ends on a soft sustained chord. No vocals, no drums.
candidates.c: Light textural ambient instrumental at 120 BPM, soft mallets and glassy bells over a warm sustained pad, subtle bass pulse, spacious and minimal, relaxed and precise. Slowly builds a little, then lands on a calm final note. No vocals, no drums.
